$comment: What is enforced vs convention. Category keys are the exact token-catalog.json keys (verify_all.py checks).

colorRoles.rule: Reference colorRoles; never emit raw hex. Only the foundation palette exists.

typeRoles.rule: Headings use display (Altriviera, licensed), body uses sans (Inter).

radiusRoles.rule: Radius is always 0. Rounded corners are off-brand.

spacingRoles.rule: Use the observed rem scale; rem rides the fluid root.

layoutRoles.rule: Every band sits inside the 90rem container between 0.5px side rails.

motionPatterns.rule: PageSpec motion.patterns is a closed enum per section (schema) and a subset of the contract's allowedPatterns (semantic_validate.py MOTION_PATTERN_ALLOWED).

overrides.note: A PageSpec has NO per-instance style/token override field: styling is owned by section/component contracts. There is therefore nothing token-related to mutate at the PageSpec layer; token drift is guarded at the catalog/policy layer by verify_all.py.

excludedTokens.reason: Declared in tailwind.config.cjs and :root but used by no src utility class; only appears baked into two eyebrow SVG files.
Declared in tailwind.config.cjs but unused; the original dropdown-list background is #ddd0 (transparent).
Declared maxWidth.narrow is not used by any src section.

fontLicensing.display: Altriviera is a paid, licensed font. Do not embed, subset or redistribute it in generated output; fall back to Arial, sans-serif where no licence exists.
